plugin.name: Share registration link
plugin.description: Users create sign-up links with a share code in the user center. When someone signs up through a link, both the sharer and the new user get score. You can cap how many times each sharer is rewarded.

field.codeHelp: Filled in when you open a link someone shared. Leave it empty if you don't have one.

confirm.delete: Sign-ups through this link will no longer be rewarded. Accounts already created through it are not affected.

error.tooMany: You can have at most {max} links. Delete one you no longer use first.

score.sharee: Signed up through a shared link

sharerScore.label: Score for the sharer
sharerScore.help: Score the sharer gets for each new user who signs up through their link. 0 gives none.

shareeScore.label: Score for the new user
shareeScore.help: Extra score for a new user who signs up through a link. 0 gives none.

maxRewardsPerSharer.label: Rewards per sharer
maxRewardsPerSharer.help: After this many, sign-ups through the sharer's links still succeed but neither side gets score. 0 means no limit.

widget.title: Share sign-up
widget.both: Each new user who signs up through your link earns you {sharer} points, and they get {sharee} points too.
widget.sharer: Each new user who signs up through your link earns you {sharer} points.
widget.sharee: New users who sign up through your link get {sharee} extra points.
widget.left: You can earn {left, plural, one {# more reward} other {# more rewards}}.
widget.capped: You've reached the limit of {max} rewards. Sign-ups through your link still work, but neither of you earns points.
widget.registrations: {count, plural, one {# person has} other {# people have}} signed up through your links.
widget.noRegistrations: No one has signed up through your links yet.
widget.none: You don't have a link yet. Generate one on the Share sign-up page.
